name: lich-sandbox
description: M5 Bounded Subprocess Dry-Run. Confirms M1-flagged runtime-failure candidates by executing witness inputs in a stdlib-only sandbox (resource.setrlimit for CPU/AS/NOFILE/FSIZE + signal.alarm for wall-clock). Unix-only at launch; Windows skips M5 with platform-unsupported verdict.
